title: Build analysis history view with pagination and search
acceptance_criteria: History page at /dashboard/history shows all analyzed resumes in a table/list
Each row shows: filename, upload date, analysis date, file size, status indicator
Clicking a row navigates to /dashboard/resumes/[id] for full results
Server-side pagination with 10 items per page
Search/filter by filename or date range
Empty state shown when no resumes have been uploaded
